name: synkrisis
description: Checked cohort construction and bounded diagnosis over validated run observations; rendering and verification are held runbook steps.

interface.shortDescription: Checked cohort construction and bounded diagnosis over validated run observations; rendering and verification are held runbook steps.
interface.longDescription: Synkrisis owns bounded comparison across validated Promise Machine run observations, and version 0.3.0 lands the reading itself. An operator names a manifest of validated, redacted, receipt-bound observation records and a comparison policy classifying every run-context dimension; cohort construction checks the producer contract, recomputes digests and bound prefixes, holds the declared caps, and classifies every declared run as included, excluded with the exact policy field responsible, or unknown. Diagnosis then applies a digest-bound catalogue of deterministic rules to that cohort, running only the rules whose required dimensions, fields and minimum samples hold and recording every refused rule with its reason. A finding is a bounded inferred relation with its evidence, counterevidence, unknown runs, the nearest claim it refuses and one suggested handoff from a named owner set. The held runbook steps still refuse: rendering will emit a fixed-template report, and verification a whole-path byte recomputation. A person decides what happens. Synkrisis never calls a model, judges model quality, states a cause, files an issue, edits a repository or dispatches another skill.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $synkrisis to build one checked cohort from declared run observations under my comparison policy, then diagnose it against the committed rule catalogue.
